verdict.rationale: Delaware's franchise-tax and annual-report portal, its only mandatory-online filing, documents a keyless entry. Users start by entering a Business Entity File Number, with an optional saved-session ID and a name-search link for finding the number, and no account creation is required. The page does carry an image CAPTCHA, and formation itself has no transactional portal, only PDF upload, fax or mail, so the keyless path covers the post-formation flow rather than incorporation. Missing for 10: a documented keyless online path for formation or name reservation, and hands-on or independent corroboration that the file-number flow completes without an account.
